title: ssh: Support the "none" (NULL) cipher
description:
Support the "none" (NULL) cipher. Add a preference to ignore checking
the MAC, as the example capture file uses an unsupported MAC.

Return out of ssh_calc_mac before calling libgcrypt with an unsupported
bogus -1 MAC value, to avoid warnings to stderr.

Ping #16054
